cinematic_style: An unstyled live-action photograph of a real person, carrying no rendering signature a viewer could name. Fully realistic human proportions with ordinary asymmetry left intact. Skin holds its true texture — visible pores, fine vellus hair, uneven tone — neither smoothed nor sharpened. Surfaces show only the sheen that real skin and real cloth have. Detail is moderate and even across the whole frame, resolved everywhere and emphasised nowhere. No line work, no medium texture, no stylisation of form.

outline.logline: Warehouse manager Jenna falls for rookie Noah, unaware he is the owner's heir, until his father's sudden arrival unmasks him before he can confess.
outline.main_story:
【The Rookie】
Jenna inspects inexperienced rookie Noah on the warehouse floor and leads him straight into physical work.

【No Special Treatment】
Noah quietly arranges a refrigerated trailer to clear a stranded medical shipment, earning Jenna's respect.

【The Man She Respects】
Noah helps Jenna work through a difficult inventory ledger late at the desk, drawing them closer together.

【Rain Between Them】
Sheltering from the rain under an awning, Noah nearly touches Jenna as an evening broadcast stirs his hidden burden.

【The Truth Almost Told】
Caleb confronts Noah in the locker room, prompting Noah to rush out and reach Jenna before it is too late.

【His Real Name】
Richard Sterling intercepts Noah on the warehouse floor, revealing Noah's true identity right before Jenna.
outline.pace: Warm and steadily building through the workplace beats, then tightening fast once Caleb raises the deadline, snapping shut hard on the reveal.
outline.emotional_tone: Emotionally grounded, concise, and progressively romantic.

assets.space: A vast industrial warehouse interior featuring polished concrete floors with faded yellow safety striping, towering dark navy industrial steel shelving bays loaded with shrink-wrapped wooden pallets, cardboard cartons, and crates. An exposed steel truss ceiling spans overhead alongside suspended industrial metal conduit and dangling high-bay pendant lights. Along the upper clerestory walls, a series of high, dusty industrial-grid windows punctuate the corrugated steel siding and aged brick perimeter, opening into the wide central aisle.

env.light: Cool morning daylight filters through the high clerestory windows, casting long, soft diagonal shafts across the upper steel framing and pallets. Down below, overhead high-bay industrial lamps provide crisp, pale white, neutral illumination across the central concrete aisle and lower racks, mixing cool ambient morning spill with clean interior overhead light.

assets.space: A commercial loading dock area within the warehouse facility, centered around two large roll-up corrugated metal overhead bay doors open to an exterior asphalt turnaround apron. The interior floor is heavy-duty worn concrete marked by scuffs and wheel tracks. Along the loading threshold are yellow steel safety bollards, hydraulic dock levelers, stacked insulated thermal shipping crates, and ratchet strap coils hanging from wall-mounted hooks.

env.light: Diffused overcast afternoon daylight pours directly through the wide open roll-up bay doors, creating a soft, broad wash of cool grey ambient light that sweeps across the loading dock floor and highlights the edges of the crates, balanced by weak ceiling-mounted fluorescent battens deeper in the bay.

assets.space: A compact supervisor office situated inside the warehouse, partitioned by half-wall painted drywall and upper interior glass windows looking back out into the storage floor. Against the interior wall sits a heavy, scratched dark wood desk piled with paper ledgers, clipboards, and desk organizers, flanked by two utilitarian swivel task chairs. A metal filing cabinet stands in the corner beside a pinboard filled with shipping manifests and duty rosters.

env.light: Illumination is centered on a small adjustable gooseneck desk lamp casting a focused, warm yellow pool across the scratched wood desk surface and paper ledgers, while the surrounding office edges recede into deep, warm shadow under the dormant overhead fixture.

assets.space: An exterior covered threshold at the warehouse side entrance, sheltered beneath a deep corrugated metal roof overhang supported by structural steel brackets. The back wall is weathered dark red brick with a heavy steel industrial exit door and conduit piping. Out past the concrete walkway curb lies a paved asphalt yard and parking bay bordered by chain-link perimeter fencing.

env.light: Deep dusky slate-blue twilight fills the open rainy yard outside, while a single bare exterior amber bulb mounted high under the corrugated metal awning casts a localized warm golden glow down against the wet concrete walkway and weathered brick wall, throwing long soft shadows.

assets.space: A narrow employee locker room enclosed by painted cinderblock walls, with rows of tall, dark green painted steel lockers lining both walls. A central wooden bench on black iron pedestals runs along the narrow aisle between locker banks. A solid fire door marks the primary exit, beside a wall-mounted bulletin board and hooks. There are no exterior windows.

env.light: Flat, cool white light provided by exposed overhead fluorescent tube ceiling fixtures in utilitarian metal housings, casting crisp, even illumination down along the locker faces, the central bench, and the speckled linoleum tile floor.

beats.title: The Rookie
beats.visual_description: Jenna stands beside a tall metal shelving unit holding a black clipboard, facing Noah who stands three feet away in crisp work clothes. Overhead industrial lamps cast pale white light across concrete floors and stacked wooden crates.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: Industrial workwear: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: Rookie warehouse uniform: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots
beats.seam: Noah stops with the cargo dolly beside pallet rack four, facing Jenna as she turns with her pen raised.
beats.preview_narration: When a polite newcomer walked onto Jenna's busy loading dock with spotless boots, she figured he wouldn't last through his first shift.

cuts.script: Jenna holds a black clipboard at the shipping gate, her eyes scanning Noah from head to toe as he steps onto the concrete.

dialogue.spoken_text: Clean boots, no scuffs. First time in a real freight depot?

cuts.script: Noah offers a steady, polite nod, clasping his hands behind his back without breaking eye contact.

dialogue.spoken_text: First day on the floor, ma'am. Ready to learn the ropes.

cuts.script: Jenna points a pen toward the pallet racks and turns on her heel toward aisle four.

dialogue.spoken_text: Keep up. Nobody gets a pass here just for showing up.

cuts.script: Noah matches her stride across the bay, grabbing an empty cargo dolly along the side of the bay with effortless balance.

beats.title: No Special Treatment
beats.visual_description: Jenna stands near open warehouse bay doors looking toward Noah, who is tightening a ratchet strap around insulated crates. Natural grey daylight from the loading gate cuts across the dusty concrete and reflects off their work boots.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: Industrial workwear: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: Rookie warehouse uniform: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots
beats.seam: Noah fastens the heavy cargo strap and looks over his shoulder at Jenna, waiting for her command.
beats.preview_narration: Yet when an urgent shipment was stranded with time running out, Noah quietly worked a miracle that saved the day.

cuts.script: Jenna taps her pen against a manifest beside a row of chilled medical containers marked with red tape.

dialogue.spoken_text: Dispatch cancelled our reefer truck. These vaccines spoil in two hours.

cuts.script: Noah steps behind a stacked pallet, presses a discreet phone call, and speaks in a low murmur before pocketing the device.

dialogue.spoken_text: Reroute the regional carrier from Bay Nine immediately.

cuts.script: Air brakes hiss outside as a white refrigerated trailer backs up straight into Bay Seven.

dialogue.spoken_text: How did you manage a priority hauler on five minutes' notice?

cuts.script: Noah lifts the first cargo strap with both hands, nodding toward the open bay doors.

dialogue.spoken_text: Had a contact at freight dispatch from an old job. Let's move.

beats.title: The Man She Respects
beats.visual_description: Jenna and Noah sit side by side at a scratched wooden supervisor desk beneath the yellow glow of a small desk lamp. Their heads lean close together over spread-out paper ledgers, hands resting flat against the paper.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: Industrial workwear: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: Rookie warehouse uniform: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots
beats.seam: Jenna and Noah sit motionless beside the desk lamp, both hands resting on the ledger between them.
beats.preview_narration: Staying late into the quiet night, Jenna realized he wasn't just another temporary hand, but someone she could truly trust.

cuts.script: Jenna rubs her temples over a cluttered desk covered in mismatched paper inventory ledgers.

dialogue.spoken_text: Headquarters wants this discrepancy report by midnight. My numbers don't match.

cuts.script: Noah sets two paper cups of water on the desk and pulls a folding chair alongside her.

dialogue.spoken_text: Cross-reference the inbound manifests with the shift logs. We'll do it together.

cuts.script: Their shoulders brush as Noah points a pencil tip at an unlogged discrepancy on page three.

dialogue.spoken_text: You catch logistics errors faster than anyone I've ever worked with.

cuts.script: Noah pauses his pencil on the page, looking up directly into her eyes.

dialogue.spoken_text: I care about making sure things run right for you, Jenna.

beats.title: Rain Between Them
beats.visual_description: Noah and Jenna stand close together beneath the corrugated metal roof overhang while heavy rain sheets down into the dark yard outside. A faint amber light bulb casts long shadows behind them on the brick exterior.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: Industrial workwear: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: Rookie warehouse uniform: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots
beats.seam: Noah holds his hand suspended in midair beside Jenna's arm, looking down at her as rain drips off the roof edge.
beats.preview_narration: Sheltering from the pouring rain, Jenna spoke of her disdain for corporate heirs, never imagining the man standing inches away was one himself.

cuts.script: Rain pours from the metal awning while an old radio atop a storage crate broadcasts an evening business report.

dialogue.spoken_text: Richard Sterling's heir is taking over the firm soon. Another billionaire playing executive.

cuts.script: Noah stops under the awning, his fingers tightening against the strap of his canvas tool bag.

dialogue.spoken_text: What if the guy actually wants to earn his place from the ground up?

cuts.script: Jenna steps closer to Noah to avoid the dripping runoff, tilting her chin up toward him.

dialogue.spoken_text: Rich kids don't sweat on concrete docks. Real men like you do.

cuts.script: Noah swallows hard, his hand reaching out and hesitating an inch from her forearm.

beats.title: The Truth Almost Told
beats.visual_description: Caleb and Noah stand face-to-face inside a narrow locker room between rows of painted green steel lockers under humming fluorescent tubes. Noah holds one locker door half-open while Caleb blocks the exit doorway.
beats.wardrobe: Noah Sterling: Rookie warehouse uniform: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots ｜ Caleb: Experienced warehouse staff: faded denim work shirt over a black t-shirt, dark utility trousers
beats.seam: Noah pushes through the double doors into the hallway with an open palm extended forward.
beats.preview_narration: A coworker uncovered Noah's real identity, urging him to tell her the whole truth before the clock ran out.

cuts.script: Caleb blocks the locker room exit, crossing his arms as Noah fastens his utility belt.

dialogue.spoken_text: I saw your executive access badge in your locker. You're Richard Sterling's son.

cuts.script: Noah grips Caleb's shoulder firmly, shaking his head in quiet plea.

dialogue.spoken_text: Keep it down. I'm telling Jenna today before the board tours the facility.

cuts.script: Caleb steps aside but points toward the corridor door where footsteps echo outside.

dialogue.spoken_text: Tell her yourself right now, or she'll think everything between you was a lie.

cuts.script: Noah bursts through the swinging locker doors and hurries straight into the main aisle.

dialogue.spoken_text: Jenna! Wait, I have to tell you something important.

beats.title: His Real Name
beats.visual_description: Richard Sterling in his charcoal three-piece suit stands between Jenna and Noah in the wide warehouse aisle, his hand resting on Noah's shoulder. Jenna stands three paces back with her arms slack, staring at Noah in disbelief.
beats.wardrobe: Jenna Morales: Industrial workwear: durable dark canvas utility vest over a grey long-sleeve shirt, fitted jeans, and steel-toed boots ｜ Noah Sterling: Rookie warehouse uniform: clean navy blue polo shirt, khaki work pants, and sturdy leather boots ｜ Richard Sterling: High-end corporate executive: tailored charcoal grey three-piece suit, crisp white shirt, and a dark silk tie
beats.seam: Jenna stands frozen in the center of aisle four, watching Noah get guided toward the executive staircase.
beats.preview_narration: Before Noah could speak, his powerful father stepped onto the dock and tore away the disguise, leaving their fragile trust shattered on the floor.

cuts.script: Jenna turns to face Noah mid-aisle, but freezes as sharp dress shoes click loudly on the concrete behind her.

dialogue.spoken_text: Jenna, about who I really am—

cuts.script: Richard Sterling strides forward in an immaculate charcoal suit, placing a heavy hand on Noah's shoulder.

dialogue.spoken_text: Good work on the floor, son. The board is waiting upstairs for your formal introduction.

cuts.script: Jenna steps backward two full paces, her hands falling limp at her sides as she stares at Noah.

dialogue.spoken_text: Son? You're Sterling's heir... Was all of this just an inspection to you?

cuts.script: Noah reaches out to her as Richard turns him toward the stairs, leaving Jenna standing alone in the aisle.

dialogue.spoken_text: No, Jenna, listen to me—it wasn't like that!

storyboard.visual_tone: Cool industrial daylight mixed with practical overhead sodium and fluorescent fixtures, throwing crisp shadows across aged concrete and corrugated metal. Surfaces carry worn textures of steel shelving and dusty wood pallets, with a muted palette of dark navy, slate grey, and weathered brick.
storyboard.video_global_setup:
GLOBAL SETUP
  PERFORMANCE KEY
  JENNA: outward authority, under pressure her jaw sets tighter, never loses her sharp gaze.
  NOAH: outward calm, under pressure his blink rate increases, never raises his voice above a steady murmur.
  CALEB: outward warmth, under pressure his brow furrows deeply, never breaks eye contact.
  RICHARD: outward command, under pressure his chin lifts fractionally, never breaks his rigid posture.
